notes:
Optional background update alerts for the direct Android / Android-based Fire TV edition.

- Enable Background update notifications in Settings > About & support > App updates.
- Checks about every six hours while connected and battery is not low; Android may defer them.
- Alerts appear once per compatible newer version and open the update screen.
- Notification permission is requested only when opting in. Manual checks remain available.
- No automatic downloads or installation; existing APK verification and recording safeguards remain.
- Includes the first-run lawful-use notice, free-app information and website/donation links.
- Amazon edition remains store managed and excludes the direct updater.

Install over your existing direct-download installation; do not uninstall it.
Older updater-enabled versions can find this release through Check for updates.
Background alerts require this version (or newer) and explicit opt-in.
These are periodic local notifications, not instant server push messages.
Physical Samsung and Fire device testing remains necessary.
